description: Shiori's regular date conversations in SERIFU/DATE_FU.BIN (load address 0x80198000; section/place map in game-internals 6k). Translated so far: section 0, the Art Museum date (place 7; 0x0-0x6A8, 30 strings): five exhibitions (variant byte 0x800CA2FC = 0-4; each: going in, Shiori's remark, a three-way player choice, Shiori's reply picked by the chosen option) and variant 5, 'we saw this before', whose three lines (0x660/0x688/0x6A8) are picked by her standing. Speaker codes: 00 player, 01 Shiori, 03 player choice (the game shows the options in shuffled order and draws the brackets, so each option has an even letter count), 02 Shiori's reply (one {q} option per choice). Identical lines share one copy (share_identical); 1272 of 1624 pooled bytes. Verified in DuckStation with forced museum dates (force_date.py --set-at, docs/testing.md): all five exhibitions with every choice and reply, and variant 5's three lines (0x688 by raising her affection, 0x660 by redirecting the part pointer). The meeting, ending, going-home and impression lines around it are other sections/files and still Japanese.
